import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

title: Budget and Revenue
text:
Budget and Revenue
Figure 1 shows the relationship between production budget and worldwide revenue.

plt.scatter(
    films["budget_musd"],
    films["revenue_musd"]
)

plt.xlabel("Budget (million USD)")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide revenue (million USD)")
plt.show()







Figure 1: Production budget and worldwide revenue

title: Runtime and Ratings
text:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

title: Runtime and Ratings
text:
Runtime and Ratings
Figure 1 shows the relationship between film runtime and IMDb rating.

plt.scatter(
    films["runtime_min"],
    films["imdb_rating"]
)

plt.xlabel("Runtime (minutes)")
plt.ylabel("IMDb rating")
plt.show()







Figure 1: Film runtime and IMDb rating
